stories.title: Hires of love ❤️
stories.description:
Some love stories begin with destiny. Ours began with war."
Riya Malhotra and Ishaan Singhania were born into two of Mumbai's most powerful billionaire families-families that have spent twenty-five years destroying each other.
Raised on stories of betrayal, they know only one truth:
Malhotras never trust Singhanias.
Singhanias never forgive Malhotras.
Their reunion begins with a ₹100 crore bidding war, sharp words, and a promise to never fall in love.
She thinks he's arrogant, cold, and impossible to tolerate.
He believes she's dramatic, stubborn, and completely infuriating.
But when an unknown enemy starts pulling the strings from the shadows, long-buried secrets begin to unravel. The feud they inherited may have been built on lies... and the people they trust most may be hiding the truth.
As hatred turns into obsession, and obsession into something far more dangerous, Riya and Ishaan must choose between loyalty to their families and the one thing they never expected to find in each other-love.
In a world of billion-dollar empires, hidden betrayals, and impossible choices, one question remains...
Can love survive a war it never started?
A slow-burn billionaire enemies-to-lovers romance filled with banter, family secrets, mystery, heartbreak, and unforgettable chemistry.

user.fullname: q r s t r y x i i

stories.description:
Five friends. One cabin.

What was supposed to be four days of freedom in the woods turns into a nightmare when Carson finds a body tangled in rope beneath the lake's surface. Before they can even process it, their cars vanish - someone wants them stranded.

Habang papasapit na ang gabi, one of them, Cole, reveals a family secret buried at this very lake three years ago. But the deeper they dig, the clearer it becomes: hindi sila nag-iisa rito, at kung sino man ang nag-iwan ng katawan hindi pa iyon tapos.

How well you really know the people you trust?

stories.title: Unnoticed, Until You.
stories.description:
Growing up in a family constantly under the public eye, Dr. Ling Kwong learned early on how to become invisible. Blamed for a childhood tragedy and overshadowed by her famous family, she lives quietly in the background of her own life, pouring everything into her work as a neurosurgeon where no one expects anything from her.


But when an emergency brings Orm-a hard-working kinder teacher-into the hospital, their two very different worlds collide. Amidst the sterile halls and exhausting quiet hours, Orm begins to notice the silent details everyone else misses: the tired eyes behind the surgical mask, the unspoken grief, and the gentle heart hidden underneath.


 For a doctor used to being forgotten, Orm's gentle gaze might just be the first place Ling feels like she truly belongs.

stories.title: Dear Diary...  // A Stranger Things Fanfic
stories.description:
Dear Diary,

It's me again.

And well, if you're reading this, then I suppose it's time to tell you about my time in a little town called Hawkins.

You may think, What could possibly happen in a town in the middle of nowhere?

Well, I'm here to tell you that stranger things have happened.

It all started in 1983.

But that wasn't my first trip to Hawkins.

The first time I ever came here was in 1975. Mom, Dad, Sarah, and I took a trip to visit Grandpa. But that's a story for another time.

For now, enjoy the almost downright depressing story of my life, and the short period of time when I was a bit of a bitch.

But trust me, it isn't all sad.

For the most part.

Oh, and if this is Steve reading this-

I'm going to kick your ass.

Sincerely,
Harley Hopper

stories.title: Where Blackbird Flies
stories.description:
Regulus Black was a closed door. James Potter had never been particularly good at taking a hint. Everyone knows Regulus as the boy who keeps his distance, sharp edges and secrets intact. James knows him differently. Or at least, he wants to.
Somewhere between the arguments and the laughter, the late nights and the things neither of them says, James finds himself standing on the other side of a door Regulus never meant to open. James only knows that every time Regulus tells him to go away, he finds another reason to stay.

stories.title: Ms. Overcomer's Spiritual Awakening
stories.description:
Before you can step into who you're meant to be, you have to burn down who you used to be.

Ms. Overcomer's Spiritual Awakening is an unvarnished, high-stakes dive into the quiet war between past baggage and personal liberation. Through a raw inventory of old heartbreaks, abandoned connections, and sudden, razor-sharp revelations, this story peels back the layers of what it truly costs to reclaim your power.

From analyzing former crushes and lingering relationships to navigating vivid dreams, sudden visions, and the sudden quiet of mental clarity, this isn't just a story about healing, it's a blueprint for rising. It's an intimate, fearless chronicle of making peace with where you've been, taking ownership of where you stand, and stepping fully into your truth.

Old roots cut. Old stories rewritten. The awakening has already begun-are you ready to step in?

An Unspoken Sequel to Ms. Overcomer the Prayer Warrior by CayeRenee_1234 (Previous Account)
